cases.name: Linda Burford
cases.about: She was dating the bartender at the tavern and was a former waitress there.
cases.narrative:
On 6/12/1980 Pauley entered the Barn Door Tavern and found five people inside, Mr. Pauley and the accomplice brandished their weapons and forced the victims to lie down on the floor. The three women were forced at gunpoint to remove their clothing; two were then tied together with electrical cords around their necks, and the third was hung with a cord around her neck to a bar railing, which strangled her to death. The two men were tied up with electrical cord and sent back to the cooler, where Mr. Pauley shot both of them in their heads while they were bound. Mr. Pauley and his accomplice fled the scene. Two of the women survived after losing consciousness and being left for dead. 

Police alleged that Linda was raped before she was hanged from a railing in the bar.
